t: The Fortress Trade Double Arm Roller Frame 12" is a robust and durable tool designed for efficient paint application on large surfaces. Constructed from high-quality stainless steel, this roller frame offers lasting performance and resistance to corrosion. Its double arm design ensures even pressure distribution across 12" roller sleeves, delivering a consistently smooth and professional finish. The frame securely attaches to UK screw fixing extension poles, providing extended reach for high walls and ceilings. This versatile painting accessory is an essential choice for professional decorators and serious DIY enthusiasts tackling extensive renovation projects.
b: Double Arm Design Ensures Even Pressure & Finish
